title: Find Missing Letters
prompt: A pangram helper checks which lowercase alphabet letters are not present in a sentence. Write a function that returns a string of missing letters in alphabetic order.

explanation.beginner:
Example: findMissingLetters("abc xyz") produces "defghijklmnopqrstuvw". The result must follow this precise rule: A pangram helper checks which lowercase alphabet letters are not present in a sentence. Write a function that returns a string of missing letters in alphabetic order. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns empty for pangrams”: input ["the quick brown fox jumps over a lazy dog"] produces "". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
